regression_run.change: Temporary system-prompt instruction: when a merchant asks about a policy, walk through the full policy background before answering.

explanation: The instruction made the frozen narrates_or_overexplains-v6 judge fail e-011 in 2 of 5 runs, and the regression rule blocks on any failed run, so CI run 1 blocked. After the revert, e-011 passed all 5 runs and CI run 2 passed, so the original behavior returned. Five passes do not prove the regression is gone for good: if the per-run pass rate were p, all 15 regression trials pass with probability p^15.
